newsitem.title: USA: Deeptech to refinance subordinated debt.
newsitem.headline: Deeptech to refinance subordinated debt.

text.p: DeepTech International Inc said Thursday it has entered into an agreement with BT Securities Corp to refinance all of its subordinated debt.
Deeptech said it agreed to issue $15.35 million principal amount of unsecured notes to refinance a similar amount of subordinated debt held by BT Securities.
The new notes are due May 31, 2000 and bear interest at a rate of 11 percent per annum, payable quarterly, it said.
The notes refinance $6.0 million of 15 percent subordinated debt due in July 1997 and $9.35 million of 10 percent unsecured debt due in November 1997.
BT Securities is a unit of Bankers Trust New York Corp.

DeepTech is a diversified energy company engaged, through its operating subsidiaries, in offshore contract drilling services and the acquisition, development, production, processing, transportation and marketing of, and the exploration for, oil and gas located offshore the United States in the Gulf of Mexico and offshore eastern Canada.
